title: Chapter 306
text:
Baby Bear, who was lazily lying beside Aurora, stood up and growled at Kerlodd in warning. Han Xiao asked Aurora to take care of Baby Bear for a long time. At this time, the bear had already grown to half the height of a human and was approaching its teenage years. There was also a strange change. Its fur seemed to be shining slightly, and its attributes were gradually changing to that of an elite. It seemed to have mutated and had gained characteristics that shouldn't be there.

Aurora's Esper ability seemed to have the effect of catalyzing the evolution of life. Young individuals who stayed by her side would experience special growth. Some time ago, Han Xiao found out that Aurora's Esper ability was called [Dawn of Life]. Her potential was the same as Hella's, which was S rank. This discovery made him very excited.

The source of this information was, of course, the battle information. Of course, it was not him attacking Aurora. He found that he had fallen into the wrong mindset. It was fine to let Aurora attack him. However, no matter what he said, Aurora always shook her head like a rattle-drum. She was unwilling to attack Han Xiao. She thought that Han Xiao was dissatisfied with her in some way, so she felt wronged and teared up.

In Aurora's heart, there were only two people close to her in the world. One was her sister Hella, and the other was Han Xiao, who tore open the darkness and brought her light when she was in the deepest despair. Other than her sister, only Han Xiao was good to her. These two were the only people she could rely on. Therefore, she cared a lot about Han Xiao, just like her own brother.

It was not easy for him to use the excuse of testing the armor's performance to make Aurora shoot at him. Only then did Han Xiao get the information. His initial target was only Hella, but Aurora also had the same level of potential. It was like a buy one get one free, which made him very happy.

In the original storyline, Aurora had been nipped in the bud, and her future achievements were unknown. This time, she had a chance to grow up. Moreover, this little girl was much more dependable than her older sister. She was another potential asset.

Han Xiao gave Hella a look, got up and walked to the side. The following words needed to be discussed in private.

After a while, Hella walked over and stood side by side with him. She frowned and asked, "What's the matter?"

"Would you like to leave this planet with me?"

"Why did you invite me?" Hella's eyes moved slightly as she turned to look at Han Xiao's side profile.

"Not only you, but also your sister. I know that you two won't separate."

Hella lowered her head and pondered. After a moment of silence, she slowly said, "I'm not leaving."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "I asked Bennett the same question. It's understandable that he didn't come, but why did you refuse?"

"It's dangerous," Hella said. "I need to take care of my sister."

"It's still dangerous to stay here."

Hella's face sank. "What did you foresee this time?"

Han Xiao roughly described the Mutation Disaster and said, "Even if you stay on this planet, the disaster will find you sooner or later. You and Aurora have a lot of potential, and your future is destined to be in the universe. Are you not going to leave with me?"

Hella lowered her eyes and fell into hesitation.

The silent atmosphere was like the lonely moon hanging high in the night sky.

After a long time, Hella turned around and said softly, "I'm not going."

Han Xiao looked at her deeply, lit a cigarette, and puffed out a mouthful of smoke. "Okay, I got it."

His tone was very casual, and he did not have any intention to probe further. This caused Hella to be puzzled. She frowned and said, "You don't want to know the reason?"

Han Xiao laughed. "Don't think too highly of yourself. I'm just casually asking. Whether you come or not won't affect me much. With your current strength, you won't be able to help me much."

Hella's eyes turned cold. Although she had rejected Han Xiao, she could feel the Han Technician's nonchalant attitude. She could feel the resentment of not being valued, and she could not keep her face straight.

At this time, Han Xiao added, "This is your own choice. I won't force you to do anything in the name of doing it for your own good."

As he said that, Han Xiao took out a bunch of keys and tossed it to Hella. "If there comes a day when the darkness swallows the sanctuary, this bunch of keys will lead to my secret base. It will allow you to hide. I put the address in a secret compartment in my office, the third drawer on the left. I'll leave it to you."

Hella played with the keys, and her expression was dark. Suddenly, she said, "Are you not coming back?"

Han Xiao smiled faintly. "You're very concerned about me?"

Hella snorted and waved the keys to show that she had remembered it. She turned around and left.

When she took a few steps, she heard Han Xiao's laughter behind her.

"Don't die."

Hella paused her footsteps.

"You too."

After Hella left, Han Xiao's smile faded. He threw down the cigarette butt and stepped on it to extinguish it.

In his estimation, the probability of Hella leaving with him was more than fifty percent. He did not expect Hella to make another choice. He had already analyzed the pros and cons, but Hella still chose to stay. Other than her sister, there might be other considerations. Hella's personality before she turned evil was not easy to guess.

However, Han Xiao did not have an urgent need for Hella at the current stage. A stock with potential that had not matured was useless. Hella would not be of much help at the moment, and her usefulness could not even be compared to those high level players who could be used as cannon fodder.

Furthermore, if he brought Hella along, he would definitely bring along Aurora. The current Aurora was even weaker, and the slightest wave could hurt her. Furthermore, the galaxy was filled with all kinds of known and unknown dangers. Even if Han Xiao was familiar with this place, he was still very cautious.

Players were the best support. They would not die, and they could work as hard as they wanted. At the same time, Han Xiao could enjoy the freedom of moving alone. There were also benefits to not bringing others along.

Since that was the case, it might be a good choice to let Hella and Aurora stay in Blue Star. There were still two to three years before the Mutation Disaster, and the two of them would have a safe environment to grow in. If they followed him, they would immediately be in danger.

Letting the two of them grow strong and wait for the Mutation Disaster to erupt before coming back to take them back was not a bad idea in Han Xiao's eyes.

Although that was the case, after being rejected twice, Han Xiaoxin was still very hurt. He muttered to himself, "Is my charm really that bad? That's impossible."

A sound came from the side, and Yi Yeqing walked out from the shadows. Han Xiao had long noticed that she was hiding by the side. He glanced at her and asked, "How much did you hear?"

"Everything." Yi Yeqing had a shocked expression. "Is what you said true? If you leave, aren't you afraid that I will leave as well? You exchanged me with you, but now you don't need me anymore? "

"You're free, but it's best that you stay in the Sanctuary. I wasn't joking when I said the Mutation Disaster."

Yi Yeqing had a complicated expression. She nodded and turned around to leave. Han Xiao narrowed his eyes as he looked at her back and shook his head.

The prisoners on the Bell of Death Island were new characters that had appeared in Version 2.0, and Yi Yeqing was one of them. He had gotten her out in advance, and Yi Yeqing would be able to develop a medicine that could suppress the Mutation Disaster in the future.

The human heart was hard to control, but he felt that the chances of Yi Yeqing staying behind were not small. She was someone who cherished her life and was passionate about medicine research. With so many players in the Sanctuary, it was the best place to experiment, and Yi Yeqing was very attractive to him.

…

Bringing along fifty experts was an important part of the plan. After the Pro League ended, when the players were still unsatisfied, he could start to implement it.

Now that the finals had already been completed, it would be done in a few days. Han Xiao was also thinking about how to bring the players away.

On this day, Raylan bypassed Bennett and contacted Han Xiao directly, giving him an ultimatum. His wording was very strict.

"Black Phantom, we know that you have captured Godora's messenger. You have made a big mistake. We respect your contribution in the Germinal Organization battle, but we will not allow you to do whatever you want. Hand over Godora's messenger. This will be your last warning. Otherwise, we will take coercive measures, and you will become our enemy. You will not want to see this happen. Although you are strong, you are not a match for the country."

"Hello, goodbye."

Kacha.

Han Xiao hung up the call, rubbed his nose, and looked helpless.

Raylan did not give up and wanted to pressure him, but Han Xiao did not want to waste time talking to them.

Han Xiao was sitting in his office, and Kerlodd was beside him. Han Xiao brought him everywhere he went. This Godora person was leaning against the window, carefully observing the players in the square. He suddenly spoke.

"Is this the special phenomenon of your planet?"

Kerlodd still remembered the investigation mission. During this period, he had also discovered the so-called 'Inhuman Phenomenon' and saw the characteristics of many players.
